historical_6_6_93_reference.note: Early OpenWrt 24.10 (6.6.93, 816,748B) and Panel1 custom 6.6.110 build (829,464B with unstripped local STT_FUNC symbols in 25,781B .strtab and 384B .gnu.linkonce.this_module) share the exact sk_buff->data=+0xa4 struct layout, whereas official OpenWrt 24.10.4 r28959-29397011cc upstream release (815,640B, 11,959B .strtab, 352B .gnu.linkonce.this_module) places sk_buff->data at +0xa8.

cross_version_abi_summary.migration_gate_verdict: NEVER copy Panel1-Guarida's 829,464-byte mac80211.ko (this_module=384B, skb->data=0xa4, sha256=19a8fde6...) onto upstream OpenWrt 24.10.4 6.6.110 images (this_module=352B, skb->data=0xa8) or vice versa: mismatched this_module fails module_layout with -ENOEXEC, and mismatched 0xa4 vs 0xa8 corrupts sk_buff->head vs sk_buff->data. Panel1-Guarida (.84) retains 19a8fde6..., while Panel2-Guarida (.85) and Panel3-Guarida (.86) SquashFS repacks MUST bake 3e3d812f... generated by patch_mac80211_teb.py.

callsite_2_associated_sta_before_ap_vlan.eapol_2_of_4_race_explanation: Stock airOS 8 (WA/XC) transmits EAPOL-Key 2/4 encapsulated in a 4-address WDS QoS Data header (FC=0x8803, ToDS=1, FromDS=1) at T+1.05ms after EAPOL-Key 1/4, before hostapd finishes processing NL80211_CMD_UNEXPECTED_4ADDR_FRAME to spawn phy0-ap0.staX (NL80211_IFTYPE_AP_VLAN). mac80211 drops that first 4-addr EAPOL-Key 2/4 with RX_DROP_MONITOR (0x20000) while notifying hostapd via cfg80211_rx_unexpected_4addr_frame. hostapd creates phy0-ap0.staX within 15..40ms, and its EAPOL-Key 1/4 retry (T+100ms / T+1000ms) succeeds over phy0-ap0.staX provided the admitter keeps the 65s IE-free window closed and bridges phy0-ap0.staX into br-lan.
